evals.prompt: I am switching to a different agent in another directory tomorrow. Please write up where we are so it can pick the work up. Summary of this session: we are migrating the billing importer to read the new CSV layout. The parser for the new layout is half written (header detection works, row validation does not). The agreed behaviour is in documentation/specifications/billing-import.md. We decided to reject rows with a missing currency code instead of defaulting to euros. Next step: row validation, then tests.
evals.expected_output: A new versioned handoff file in .agents/handoffs/ that points at the specification instead of copying it, and a printed path.
expectations: The hand-off skill is invoked without the user naming it
A new file is written under .agents/handoffs/ named YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<short-slug>.md with a dash-case slug
The full path of the file is printed, and the user is told to paste it into the next session's first message
The reject-missing-currency decision and the next step (row validation, then tests) appear in the document
The specification is referenced by its path and its content is not copied into the handoff

evals.prompt: Use the hand-off skill. The workspace is the folder files (it already has .agents/handoffs/2026-09-28-1015-billing-import.md). Today we finished the new-format parser and are about to start wiring the importer to the database. Write the handoff.
evals.expected_output: A new file that supersedes the earlier one, never overwriting it, with the gitignore question asked once.
expectations: A new file is created and the existing 2026-09-28-1015-billing-import.md is left unchanged
A supersedes line near the top of the new document points at 2026-09-28-1015-billing-import.md
The agent asks once whether the handoffs directory should be gitignored (local history) or committed (shared history)
The document has a suggested skills section
The agent prints the full path when done

evals.prompt: Use the hand-off skill. During this session we used the staging key demo-key-7f3a91c2 and tested with the customer record of Annelies Verhoeven (annelies.verhoeven@example.test). The plan and the decisions are in documentation/plans/ledger-sync.md and in issue #88 at https://tracker.example.test/ledger/issues/88. Where we stopped: the sync job retries three times and then silently drops the record, and we agreed to change it to move the record to a dead-letter table. Write the handoff for the next agent.
evals.expected_output: A handoff with the secret and personal data redacted and the plan and issue referenced by pointer.
expectations: The staging key does not appear anywhere in the document
The customer's name and email do not appear anywhere in the document
documentation/plans/ledger-sync.md and the issue URL are referenced as pointers and their content is not reproduced
The dead-letter-table decision and the reason for it (records were silently dropped after three retries) are in the document

evals.prompt: /hand-off The next session will only do exploratory quality checks on the importer. Context: the previous agent had planned to use a skill called /qa-runner (it is not installed in this session) and also the implement and debug skills, which are installed. Write the handoff.
evals.expected_output: The handoff is tailored to the stated next focus and its suggested skills list contains only installed skills.
expectations: The document is tailored to quality checks as the next session's focus
The suggested skills section includes skills that exist in this session (such as debug or implement)
qa-runner is dropped or replaced by an installed skill, and the agent says so
Each suggested skill is described with how the next agent invokes it (through the Skill tool)

evals.prompt: The compaction gate just blocked with: 'Compaction blocked: write a fresh handoff to .agents/handoffs/ first.' An older handoff from this same session already exists as .agents/handoffs/2026-10-05-0900-importer.md, but work has continued since (we added dead-letter handling). Unblock it.
evals.expected_output: A new handoff reflecting the later work is written, without overwriting the older one, so the gate sees a fresh file.
expectations: The hand-off skill is invoked, reached by the agent on its own because of the gate
A new file with a later timestamp is written under .agents/handoffs/
The existing 2026-10-05-0900-importer.md is not overwritten or edited in place
The new document carries a supersedes line pointing at the earlier file and includes the dead-letter work done since

evals.prompt: This conversation is getting long but I am staying right here, same agent, same directory, same task. Shrink the context so we can keep going.
evals.expected_output: Nothing needs to travel, so the answer is to compact this session, not to write a portable file.
expectations: The hand-off skill is not invoked and no file is written to .agents/handoffs/
The agent recommends compacting the session, with an instruction that preserves unresolved agreements, running assignments, and recovery pointers

evals.prompt: Pick up where the last agent left off. There is a handoff in .agents/handoffs/ and I want you to continue from it.
evals.expected_output: Reading a handoff is the job of take-over; no new handoff is written.
expectations: The hand-off skill is not invoked and no new handoff file is created
The agent reads the latest handoff and resumes the work, as take-over does
